ledger: Station wagon | Parked on the right shoulder of a desert road; closed hood, front left fender, windshield glass, and driver-side A-pillar visible | Camera pushes in toward the front-left corner of the cabin/hood | The junction of the closed hood/fender and windshield glass intersects the woman's torso throughout the shot

Woman | Positioned at the front-left corner of the car with crossed arms resting on the closed hood/fender in front of the windshield | Remains in the same impossible position as the camera pushes in and orbits slightly | Clips directly through the solid cowl, fender, and windshield glass where no window or opening exists

Desert road and background | Desert scrub visible on the left and through the car windows at 00:00 | Highway stretching into the distance toward mountains becomes visible on the left as camera orbits at 00:02-00:09 | Parallax shift of background road is consistent with camera movement

findings.entity: Woman and station wagon (windshield, hood, and front fender)
findings.invariant_violated: impossible geometry and depth ordering / occlusion
findings.description: The woman occupies a geometrically impossible position relative to the car's structure: her torso emerges directly out of the solid junction of the cowl, closed hood/fender, and windshield, with her crossed arms resting on top of the front-left fender/hood in front of the windshield while the windshield glass and lower chrome trim terminate directly into her right side and the driver-side A-pillar sits behind her left shoulder.
